verdict.rationale: Spline's webhooks and Real-time API let a published scene automatically trigger actions, update variables and respond to external events without user input. That is a narrow, scene-runtime form of event-driven automation, not general background automation. The AI Agent and MCP server are documented only as working interactively through the open editor tab. Missing for 10: user-configurable background or scheduled automations, autonomous agent runs that continue without an open editor session, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
